IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Local Government & Housing.

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the submission of annual reports on the use of received revenues for certain housing assistance programs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to housing program reports; adding a new section tochapter 35.82 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 36.01 RCW; andadding a new section to chapter 43.185C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.82 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By December 31, 2009, and each subsequent December 31stthereafter, each housing authority created under this chapter mustprovide a report to the department of community, trade, and economicdevelopment describing how the following have been spent or otherwiseutilized: (a) Received revenues resulting from legislation pertaining tohousing assistance programs enacted after January 1, 2002; and (b) Received revenues for housing assistance programs in whichvouchers are a permissible use of funds. (2) The report required under this section must exclude revenuesreceived for capital projects and be completed within the existingfunds of each authority.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By December 31, 2009, and each subsequent December 31stthereafter, each county must provide a report to the department ofcommunity, trade, and economic development describing how the followinghave been spent or otherwise utilized: (a) Received revenues resulting from legislation pertaining tohousing assistance programs enacted after January 1, 2002; and (b) Received revenues for housing assistance programs in whichvouchers are a permissible use of funds. (2) The report required under this section must exclude revenuesreceived for capital projects and be completed within the existingfunds of each county.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.185CRCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By July 1, 2010, and each subsequent July 1st thereafter, thedepartment must submit a report to the appropriate committees of thehouse of representatives and the senate that summarizes the reportssubmitted to the department under sections 1 and 2 of this act. Thereport required under this section must be completed within theexisting funds of the department.
